Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 5  
Reason for Mistake: The mistake occurred when the WebSurfer misidentified the book "Dr. De Soto Goes to Africa" as a 1982 publication by William Steig with a mouse-dentist character. The correct book is "Doctor De Soto," and it was first published in 1982. "Dr. De Soto Goes to Africa" was a sequel and published later. The error likely stemmed from misinterpretation of search results and failure to adequately confirm the publication year and title from multiple reliable sources. This represents an example of premature conclusion based on misattributed or misunderstood information.
